opening_message:
Ticket 1: Jennifer Martin (employee ID E033) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E033.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Jennifer Martin (E033) is a full-time Analyst. She requested admin access to Payroll. As a full-time employee, her max is write; admin is only allowed for the role that owns the system (Payroll Specialist). Since the requested level is above her maximum, recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Jennifer Martin (E033) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors max is read (write requires advanced training); admin is never allowed. Requested admin is above max, so recommend granting read.
reason: Jennifer Martin (E033) is an Analyst and requested admin access to Payroll. The Security DB indicates she is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only if they have advanced security training, and never admin. Since admin is above her maximum and she lacks advanced training, the maximum grantable level is read. (Note: HR lists her as full-time, which would allow up to write, but the Security DB is the authoritative source for access entitlement and shows contractor/basic; in either case admin is not permitted. Granting read is the secure maximum.)
